title: alert/v1
description: One alert of a USSP monitor (spec 04 §3.3; Reg. (EU) 2021/664 Art. 11, 13) in the common envelope (04 §2): on alrt.v1.<kind>.<cell5>.<alert_id> from monitor to api (the alerts record) and traffic-ws, and as a body of WS /v1/alerts, WS /v1/traffic and traffic/product/v1. An alert is raised once, updated (republished every second with its current numbers while it holds, C-08) and cleared with a reason (C-06, C-14). A proximity alert is the national CPA addition: one per flight of this USSP in the pair, naming the other aircraft (peer), both sides carrying the numbers of the same judgement (C-11). The alert informs; it never carries resolution advice (2021/664 Art. 11(4), LESSONS X-15). alert_id is a UUID derived from the condition and its raise time, so a republish, a restart and a handover name the same alert.

peer.description: The other aircraft of a proximity alert: its track id (a flight id, a peer's flight id or an icao24) and its trust class, shown as such (R-05: a broadcast track is always labelled broadcast).

source.description: Adapter type the peer was heard from (04 §2).

proximity_detail.description: The CPA numbers of the last judgement that showed the conflict true (uspace-core cpa and alerting): t_cpa_s (time to the closest point of approach, 0 when diverging), d_cpa_h_m (horizontal distance at it), d_alt_m (vertical separation at it, AMSL; null when the vertical is not known, R-09), the peer, and beside them d_horizontal_now_m, vertical_separation_known, los_start_s (time to the loss of separation, 0 when inside the minima now; the ranking of active conflicts, C-19), pair_id (the same on both flights' alerts) and evaluation_period_s (1 s, or 2 s above the pair budget, spec 05 §5).

evaluation_period_s.description: 1 s, or 2 s above the pair budget; never more (spec 05 §5).

carried_since.description: Set while the alert is carried across a monitor restart, a handover or a policy change and not yet judged again.

clear_reason.description: Why a cleared alert cleared; null otherwise. resolved rests on evidence (shown false for longer than the hysteresis); stale on silence; source_disabled on a switch; landed on a not-flying sample; flight_ended on the flight's end; not_reconfirmed on an alert carried across a restart that was not judged in conflict again; acknowledged_timeout as 04 §3.3 names it.

captured_at.description: The placement of the triggering sample (04 §2).

detail.description: The numbers of the kind (04 §3.3); a proximity alert's are proximity_detail.

clearing_detail.description: On a clear: the numbers of the judgement that cleared it (C-14), or why a carried alert ended.

acked_at.description: When the operator acknowledged it (POST /v1/alerts/{alert_id}/ack); null or absent until then.

escalated_at.description: When an unacknowledged critical alert was escalated to the supervisor console (02 F5); null or absent until then.
